registered_definition: The canonical manifest is durably published and MCPs catalog acknowledgement has confirmed the validated catalog row.

implementation_decisions.catalog_backend: MCPs-owned durable PostgreSQL/Supabase tables; the catalog remains rebuildable from RustFS manifests.
implementation_decisions.internal_auth: MCP_ADMIN_SECRET over the private service network; endpoints fail closed when the secret is absent.
implementation_decisions.ack_direction: The worker POSTs an idempotent acknowledgement request to MCPs and retries while catalog_pending.
implementation_decisions.version_policy: Artifact versions are immutable sha256 digests; current-version selection is an explicit catalog pointer update.
implementation_decisions.source_resolution: MCPs resolves uploaded_files storage metadata. The worker never derives tenant scope or accepts a public path.

semantic_rules: Public locators never contain tenant, space, bucket, key, path, URI, URL, or output fields.
MCPs derives tenant and space scope from authenticated context and authoritative membership relations.
The worker acknowledges its queue only after durable registration state exists.
MCPs supplies a strong source ETag and the worker rejects missing or mismatched source identity before publication.
A registration is not registered until catalog acknowledgement succeeds.
Caller-visible authorization failures do not disclose whether a foreign dataset exists.
Manifest identity and provenance must match the server-owned registration request before catalog acknowledgement.
